10 Clear-Water Beach Hotels
on Koh Larn, Chonburi
That We've Reviewed
heroSub: 10 hand-picked Koh Larn stays we've reviewed in depth — a resort right on clear-water Samae Beach, seaside stays near Na Ban pier, a beachfront boutique pool villa, a photogenic castle-themed resort, and a loft-style place with a live-music bar. Prices start at about ฿900–4,200/night.
introH2: 🏝️ What kinds of Koh Larn hotels are there, and how do you pick one that fits your trip?
introHtml: Koh Larn is appealing because it's a clear-water island just a 30–45 minute boat ride from Pattaya, yet the places to stay are more varied than most people expect. Some are resorts right on Samae Beach or Tawaen Beach, where you step out of your room onto the sand. Some are seaside stays near Na Ban pier that you can walk to within a few minutes of getting off the boat, with no cross-island ride needed. Some are adults-only boutique pool villas by the sea with a private pool and a floating breakfast. And some lean into bold design, like a castle-themed resort or a loft-style place with a live-music bar. A lot of people book a place on the island without knowing what kind of location they'll get, only to find they're further from the sand than they hoped or facing a longer ride than expected. This article rounds up 10 Koh Larn stays we've reviewed in depth — across Samae Beach, Tawaen Beach, Nual Beach, and the Na Ban pier area — every one drawn from reading real guest reviews, with honest pros and cons, prices compared across 3 sites, and direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: Koh Larn has no city-style public transport. Getting there starts with the ferry crossing from Bali Hai Pier in Pattaya — the passenger ferry takes about 30–45 min (a fare in the tens of baht), or a chartered speedboat around 15 min. Most boats land at Na Ban Pier, the main and busiest area. The areas covered in this article: Na Ban Pier — a quick walk from where the boat lands, with shops, a market, and plenty of restaurants; many stays offer a golf cart or free shuttle. Tawaen Beach — the lively main beach with a full range of water activities and beachfront stays you can walk straight onto the sand from. Samae Beach — a small beach on the west side, clearer and quieter than the main beach. Nual Beach — a quiet, clear-water beach reached up a hill. On the island it's worth renting a motorbike for around 300 baht/day to get around the beaches, and bring enough cash since ATMs and card-accepting shops are limited.

entries.name: Xanadu Beach Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Samae Beach · step from your room into the sea · free pier transfer
entries.addr: Samae Beach, Koh Larn, Na Kluea, Bang Lamung, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: If there's one place on Koh Larn that reviews most often mention for "sleeping right on a clear-water beach without paying a fortune," many give the nod to Xanadu Beach Resort. What sets it apart from most stays on the island is its location on Samae Beach rather than the busy Tawaen Beach — Samae is a small beach on the west side that reviews consistently describe as noticeably clearer and less crowded than the main beach. The resort opened in 2012 and was renovated in 2014, with around 68 rooms lined up to face the sea, in Deluxe rooms for couples, Triples with a balcony, and Family Rooms roomy enough for kids to run around. The thing most people praise first is the private beach with free canvas loungers that you don't have to pay to rent like on the public beach, plus a seaside breakfast you eat in the shade watching fishing boats bob in the distance — which reviews call the best part of staying here. The staff also earn praise for being friendly and helping with pier transfers. The honest notes from reviews: there's no swimming pool, since the sea serves as the natural pool; the water in the rooms is filtered seawater that's fine for bathing but not for drinking; some room amenities are missing, such as no toothbrush or toothpaste; the building has been open for over a decade and is starting to show wear; and getting to Samae Beach means a roughly 15–20 minute ride across from Na Ban pier, so arrange the transfer clearly in advance. Best for families and couples who want a quiet seaside setting and value calm over luxury.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Arrange the transfer from Na Ban pier clearly in advance, since Samae Beach is on the opposite side from the pier. Bring your own bottled water and personal toiletries, and grab a beachfront lounger early on busy days.
pros: On Samae Beach — a quiet, clear-water beach you can step straight into from your room
Private beach with free canvas loungers for guests
Lovely seaside breakfast (a frequent review highlight)
Clean rooms, many with sea views, free pier transfer
cons: No swimming pool · room water is filtered seawater, not drinkable
Some amenities missing, e.g. no toothbrush or toothpaste
Building starting to age · multi-leg trip with a cross-island ride

entries.type: Boutique Resort 3★ · on Na Ban pier
entries.name: Lareena Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Na Ban pier · ~50 m from the pier · walk to everything
tags: 🌊 suite built out over the sea
🏪 walk to shops and the market
entries.addr: 61/1 Moo 7, Na Ban, Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: If you put weight on "getting off the boat and straight into your room without a cross-island ride," Lareena Resort is the name many reviews bring up first, because it's a 3-star boutique resort built out over the sea on pilings in the Na Ban village area, only about 50 metres from Na Ban pier. Once the boat docks you can wheel your bags to your room in a few minutes, and many foreign reviews note that staff often offer to drive you to and from the pier. Open since 2005 and renovated in 2019, it has around 18 rooms spread across several buildings. The highlight is the Suite On Sea With Terrace, a suite built out over the water with a balcony and deck offering an almost 180-degree view, with the lights of Pattaya across the bay as a backdrop. The décor is a bright, art-led style that's fun to photograph, and what many love most is hearing the waves break beneath the room at night, lulling them to sleep. Service is another strong point, with reviews praising how friendly the staff are and how they help book tours and call cars, pushing the overall score up to 9.0. The honest notes: there's no swimming pool; being right on the pier means boat horns and pier activity in the morning and evening; the walls in some buildings are fairly thin so you hear the next room; furniture in some rooms is older with the building's age; and room-location descriptions are sometimes off since rooms are spread across several buildings. Best for travellers who put location and the seaside atmosphere first on a not-too-expensive budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you want a sea view, ask specifically for a Sea Side or Suite On Sea room when you book, since rooms are spread across several buildings. Pack earplugs in case of morning boat noise, and confirm your room location with the resort before you travel.
pros: On Na Ban pier, ~50 m away — off the boat and walk straight to your room
Suite built out over the sea, with a balcony and an almost 180-degree view
Walk to all the shops, the market, and restaurants in the village
Friendly staff who help with travel and tours (score 9.0)
cons: No swimming pool · boat horns in the morning and evening
Thin walls in some buildings, you hear the next room · older furniture in some rooms
Room-location descriptions sometimes off (from reviews)

entries.type: Beachside Resort 3★ · near Na Ban pier
entries.name: Suntosa Resort
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.5 · 120 reviews · TripAdvisor #1 in the B&B group
entries.mrtTag: 📍 near Na Ban pier · 2–3 min walk from the pier
entries.addr: 162 Moo 7, Koh Larn, Na Kluea, Bang Lamung, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: Suntosa Resort is a small stay of about 10 rooms that takes the "off the boat and you're there" idea seriously, sitting in a lane near Na Ban pier just a 2–3 minute walk from the pier to your room. On Koh Larn, where many places require a ride across the island to far-off beaches, staying this close to the pier saves both time and transport cost, especially when hauling bags on and off the boat. Open since 2012, it's run as a hands-on family stay by the owner, and it's done well enough that TripAdvisor ranks it #1 of 51 B&B/guesthouse-type stays on Koh Larn. Rooms split into Superior and Superior Sea View, which adds a sea view from the balcony; every room has air-con, a TV, a minibar, and a hot-water bathroom. Real reviews agree the rooms are clean and that getting a sea-view balcony for low-thousands baht isn't easy to find on Koh Larn, and the owner is friendly, helping with motorbike rental and tips on where to go, plus there's a fresh seafood restaurant on site. The honest notes: there's no swimming pool and no private beach; the walls between rooms are fairly thin so you hear the next room; the entrance is a narrow sandy lane that makes wheeling bags a little awkward; some reviews found ants in the room; and reception is at times less friendly than you'd hope. Best for couples, solo travellers, and small groups of friends who want to stay near the pier on a budget, especially anyone doing a single overnight to enjoy the beaches.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a Superior Sea View room when you book if the view matters, since they're limited and fill up fast. Use a backpack rather than a large wheeled suitcase because the entrance is a narrow sandy lane, and bring earplugs in case of noise from the next room.
pros: 2–3 minute walk from Na Ban pier to your room, no extra ride needed
Clean rooms with a sea-view balcony for low-thousands baht
Friendly owner and team · TripAdvisor #1 in the B&B group
Fresh seafood restaurant and motorbike rental on offer
cons: A small stay with no swimming pool and no private beach
Walls don't block sound well, you hear the next room · entrance is a narrow sandy lane
Reception at times less friendly than you'd hope (from reviews)

entries.name: Baan Rin Rak
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Na Ban pier · ~300 m from the pier · free golf-cart pickup
entries.addr: 202 Moo 7, Na Ban Pier, Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: On Koh Larn, where most stays are still older guesthouses, finding a small minimalist seaside resort with a private pool where you can lie in bed and look at the sea is rare — Baan Rin Rak is a 3-star boutique resort that opened in 2025 near Na Ban pier and is adults-only, taking no children or noisy groups. What many talk about is the Seaview Pool Villa with a private pool in front of the room facing the sea, where you can watch the water from bed, plus a floating breakfast set that's become the signature photo spot here. The resort is only about 300–400 metres from Na Ban pier and offers a free golf-cart pickup from the pier on advance notice, so you don't have to drag your bags in the sun. Being newly opened, the furniture and décor are still spotless, and reviews say the rooms look just like the photos, are clean, and feel pricier than they cost. Room types range from Standard, Deluxe, and Deluxe Seaview up to the pool villa. The honest notes: there's no private sandy beach to walk down to from the room, so you have to rent a motorbike to reach the beach; advance replies are slow at times, especially by email; some upper-floor rooms are hot with ventilation that isn't great yet; the pool is a small private one rather than a large pool; and with only 11 rooms it fills up fast on weekends. Best for couples and honeymooners who want a pretty, quiet, private room and seaside photo moments.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Confirm the golf-cart pickup from the pier and give your boat arrival time in advance. If you're staying in the pool villa for the floating breakfast, book ahead since rooms are few and fill up fast, and allow for replies that may be slow at times.
pros: Seaview Pool Villa with a private pool + Floating Breakfast, very photogenic
Near Na Ban pier, ~300 m, with a free golf-cart pickup
New in 2025, fresh clean rooms, minimalist décor that feels pricier than it costs
Quiet and private, adults only
cons: No private sandy beach, you ride/take a motorbike to swim at the beach
Advance replies slow at times, especially by email
Only 11 rooms, fills up fast · no children (from reviews)

entries.type: Loft Boutique Resort 2★ · on the way to Nual Beach
entries.name: PAUSE Resort & Bar
entries.badge: 🎸 raw loft style with a live-music bar
entries.mrtTag: 📍 on the way to Nual Beach · ~1.2 km from the pier · shuttle ~50 baht
entries.addr: Hat Nuan Road, Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: On an island where most stays are plain seaside guesthouses, finding a small resort bold enough to play with raw bare-concrete loft design stands out — PAUSE Resort & Bar is a boutique stay that positions itself as more than just a bed. It has a small number of individually designed rooms, around 6–8, no two the same, split into the PAUSE group (larger rooms, some with their own garden corner) and PLAY (smaller rooms, some with a loft level), and the detail reviews mention most is the open-air bathroom looking up at the sky, where you can shower at night and see the stars. The heart of the place, reflected in the "& Bar" name, is the live-music bar open from evening into the late night, with a jam-session culture that foreign reviews call fun and laid-back, paired with BBQ gear for groups of friends to grill their own. It sits in the area on the way to Nual Beach, about 1.2 km from Na Ban pier, with an island shuttle of around 50 baht. The honest notes: there's no swimming pool and it's not on the beach; the most-discussed issue is noise, since the live-music bar plays late (some reviews say until 2–3 a.m.), so light sleepers may be uncomfortable on busy bar nights; the beds are fairly firm; the facilities are basic; and housekeeping is inconsistent. Best for laid-back groups of friends, couples who like a raw, edgy vibe, and people coming to Koh Larn for the experience rather than just a bed.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're a light sleeper, check whether your night falls on a live-music night, ask for a room far from the bar zone, or pick a weeknight, which is quieter. Use the 50-baht island shuttle since the road up to Nual Beach is hilly, and buy some food to grill on the BBQ in the evening.
pros: Distinctive bare-concrete loft design, unlike anything else on the island
Open-air bathroom looking up at the sky, novel and photogenic
Live-music bar and BBQ with a laid-back atmosphere
Friendly staff, with a cheap island shuttle
cons: Live-music bar plays late, light sleepers may be disturbed
No swimming pool and not on the beach, you ride/rent a motorbike to get there
Beds fairly firm · inconsistent housekeeping (from reviews)

entries.type: Small resort on Tawaen Beach · sea-themed rooms
entries.name: Sukkee Beach Resort
entries.revCount: Real reviews about 7.6 · TripAdvisor #6 of 28 stays
entries.badge: 🏖️ on Tawaen Beach, step onto the sand
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Tawaen Beach · step onto the sand · free pier transfer
entries.addr: 195/4 Moo 7, Na Ban, Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: Sukkee Beach Resort is a small resort that sells the charm of "opening your door in the morning to find the sand right there," because it sits on Tawaen Beach, the main and busiest beach on Koh Larn, with the sand just a few steps from your room — many reviews say it's about a 1 minute walk to the beach. What gives it character is its sea- and pirate-themed rooms, each one different; the most-mentioned is the Captain Room, in a newer ship-captain theme, and there's everything from small rooms for two up to large bungalows for families. The Tawaen Beach in front of the resort has a full range of water activities — jet skis, banana boats, parasailing — and there's an in-house beachfront restaurant that reviews praise for the seaside dinner atmosphere in the evening, plus a free pier transfer. TripAdvisor ranks it #6 of 28 stays on the island, with a score of around 3.4 out of 5. The honest notes worth reading in full: there's no swimming pool; the most-discussed issue is service, especially in the restaurant, which is inconsistent and sometimes slow or brings the wrong dish; the rooms and furniture are starting to age; sand gets tracked into the rooms; water pressure and air-con are inconsistent in some rooms; and your experience depends on which staff you get and when. Best for people who want to sleep right on Tawaen Beach on a budget and value the location and atmosphere over luxury.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Confirm the pier transfer with the stay in advance and which pier it will meet you at. Ask for a ground-floor or sea-facing room when you book, since not every room has the same view, and since the in-house restaurant is inconsistent, try walking to another spot on the beach.
pros: On Tawaen Beach, just a few steps onto the sand
Cute, one-of-a-kind sea/pirate-themed rooms
Seaside restaurant with a good evening atmosphere · free pier transfer
Budget-friendly compared with other beachfront stays on the island
cons: Inconsistent restaurant service, sometimes slow or the wrong order
Some rooms and furniture starting to age · sand gets tracked in
No swimming pool · service quality depends on timing (from reviews)

entries.name: The Castello Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 mid-island, near Tawaen Beach · free shuttle
entries.addr: Nai Klom, mid-island Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: The Castello Resort is the Koh Larn stay for people who want an unusual setting unlike the typical guesthouse, because it brings Italian Tuscan castle-themed architecture to the middle of a tropical island, with arched alcoves, warm-toned plaster walls, and European-style décor. What people talk about most is that every angle photographs beautifully, as if you'd stepped abroad. Open since 2014, it scores well at 8.8 from 104 reviews on Trip.com. Another highlight many reviews call the star is the in-house café and fresh-baked bakery, baking bread and pastries fresh, so you get good coffee and tasty baked goods in pretty surroundings. The resort isn't right on the beach, but there's a free shuttle between Na Ban pier and Tawaen Beach, so you don't have to carry your bags up the hill yourself. Room types range from Large Economy and Standard with a balcony to Deluxe and the Tuscany Suite, and the staff earn praise for being polite and friendly. The honest notes: there's no swimming pool, so you take the shuttle to swim at the beach; the budget rooms are fairly compact with limited shower space; the air-con is noisy in some rooms; several breakfast packages cost about 250 baht extra per adult and the menu is fairly repetitive over multiple nights; and motorbike rental on the island is fairly pricey. Best for couples and groups of friends into photography and cafés who want a good-looking stay on a not-too-expensive budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Arrange the shuttle times with the resort in advance, both when you arrive at the pier and before you leave. If you're a larger group or staying several nights, move up to Large Economy or the Tuscany Suite, since the difference isn't much but it's more comfortable, and check clearly whether your booked rate includes breakfast.
pros: Tuscan castle theme, photogenic from every angle
In-house café and fresh-baked bakery, praised for the taste
Free shuttle between the pier and Tawaen Beach, very convenient
Polite, friendly staff, clean rooms, comfortable beds
cons: No swimming pool, you go to the beach to swim · not on the beach
Budget rooms fairly compact with limited shower space
Several breakfast packages cost extra · repetitive menu over multiple nights (from reviews)

entries.type: Resort on Tawaen Beach · snorkel & squid-fishing trips
entries.name: Tawaen Beach Resort
entries.badge: 🏖️ on Tawaen Beach · free beach chairs
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Tawaen Beach · ~150 m from the sea · free pier pickup
entries.addr: Tawaen Beach, Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: Tawaen Beach Resort is a resort planted on Tawaen Beach, the most famous and liveliest beach on Koh Larn, only about 150 metres from the sand and sea, so you can walk down to swim in a few minutes. Because it's on the island's main beach, it's surrounded by a full range of water activities — banana boats, parasailing, jet skis — and ringed by restaurants and shops. The resort had a major renovation in 2016 and has around 23 rooms in several sizes, from doubles to the Deluxe Family Room with two queen beds; some rooms in reviews sleep up to about 8 people, good for groups looking to save by sharing. What reviews love is the free beach chairs and umbrellas, which other spots on Tawaen Beach usually charge to rent, plus a free songthaew pickup from the pier to the resort and snorkelling trips to see coral and squid-fishing trips that many groups call fun, pushing the overall score to 8.5 from over 200 reviews. The honest notes: there's no swimming pool; the sliding doors are fairly thin so you hear the next room; Saturday and Sunday nights have live music that can run lively into the late hours; some find the breakfast fairly small; bathroom amenities are incomplete in some rooms; and there are reviews complaining about water-activity prices that didn't match what was agreed. Best for families bringing kids to swim and groups of friends who want to stay on the island's most popular beach at an accessible price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Check with the resort which pier your booked boat will land at and confirm the free pickup in advance. If you're a light sleeper, ask for a room away from the restaurant and music spot, especially on weekend nights, and confirm the price of the snorkel/squid-fishing trips clearly before agreeing.
pros: On Tawaen Beach, just a few steps down to swim
Free beach chairs and umbrellas · free pier pickup
Snorkelling and squid-fishing trips, good for families and groups
Spacious, clean rooms with a large fridge, sleeps several
cons: No swimming pool · thin sliding doors, you hear the next room
Live music runs lively into the late hours on weekend nights · breakfast fairly small
Agree water-activity prices clearly before paying (from reviews)

entries.name: Koh Larn Sea Side Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Na Ban · ~300 m from the pier · ~5 min walk
entries.addr: 167/2 Moo 7, Na Ban, Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: On Koh Larn, where good stays in the low thousands are getting harder to find, Koh Larn Sea Side Resort is a small 3-star seaside resort of about 15 rooms with the lowest starting price in this article at around ฿900/night, and many choose it because it's only about 300 metres from Na Ban pier — off the boat and a quick walk, no long haul with the bags. Every room is air-conditioned with a balcony, a fridge, and cable TV, plus a seaside table area for evening views that reviews say has a cool breeze and an atmosphere beyond the price. But what real reviews praise most consistently is the kindness of the owner and reception who look after guests themselves; many reviews recount the owner often upgrading guests to a sea-view room at a good rate when one is free, and one review describes the service as "coming from the heart, with nothing hidden." It doesn't include a full breakfast, but there's free tea, coffee, and toast in the morning, plus free Wi-Fi and parking. The honest notes: there's no swimming pool and it's not on a sandy beach you can walk down to from the room, so you rent a motorbike to reach the beach; the rooms are simple and may show wear with age; the Na Ban area is busy during the day when boats come and go frequently; and advance booking replies can be slow at times. Best for couples and travellers who want a budget seaside room near the pier and value the owner's kindness over luxury.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a sea-view room when you book; reviews say the owner often upgrades guests at a good rate when it's not full. Plan for breakfast since a full one isn't included (there's free tea/coffee/toast), and rent a motorbike to swim at the beach.
pros: Lowest starting price in the article, with a sea-view room near the pier
Kind owner/staff who upgrade rooms, with friendly service
Near Na Ban pier, ~300 m, in the heart of the shopping area
Every room has a balcony · seaside table area to relax · free Wi-Fi/parking
cons: No swimming pool, and no full breakfast included
Simple rooms that may show wear with age · not on a sandy beach
Advance booking replies can be slow at times (from reviews)

entries.name: Toonja Koh Larn
entries.badge: 🌊 closest to the pier · highest score in the article
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Na Ban pier · ~3 min walk from the pier · free golf-cart pickup
tags: 🛺 ~3 min walk from the pier + free golf-cart pickup
entries.addr: 163 Moo 7, Na Ban Pier, Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: On Koh Larn, where most stays require a songthaew ride across the island to far-off beaches, finding a place you can walk to in about 3 minutes from Na Ban pier is rare and very convenient — Toonja Koh Larn is a small seaside Bed & Breakfast set right in the heart of the Na Ban pier area, and it's the stay with the highest review score in this article at 9.2 from 72 reviews on Trip.com. What many talk about is how convenient it is from the moment you step off the boat, since you reach the stay in a few minutes and there's also a free golf-cart pickup from the pier on advance notice of your boat arrival time. Another highlight is the King Room with Sea View, where you wake up to the sea, with a free breakfast included in the room rate; the rooms are clean and well kept, the staff are friendly and help arrange snorkelling trips and suggest places to go, all at a still-affordable rate of around ฿1,100/night. It takes adults 18 and over only, so it's quiet and suits couples and people coming for a real break. The honest notes: it's a small B&B with no swimming pool; the rooms are compact at around 16 sqm; the breakfast is still plain and not very varied; the checkout process isn't always smooth; it's on the pier side, not on a sandy beach to walk down to and swim; and it takes no children or pets. Best for couples and adult travellers who want a clean seaside stay in the location closest to the pier, on a budget, for an overnight island trip.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Message ahead with your boat arrival time at Na Ban pier so they send the free golf-cart pickup. Choose the King Room with Sea View if you want to wake up to the sea, since some Standard rooms face inward, and confirm the checkout process clearly at check-in.
pros: ~3 min walk from the pier + free golf-cart pickup, the quickest off-the-boat arrival
Highest review score in the article, 9.2 · clean, well-kept rooms
King room with sea view and free breakfast included in the rate
Quiet and private, adults only · arranges snorkelling trips
cons: No swimming pool (a small B&B) · compact rooms at around 16 sqm
Breakfast still plain · checkout process not always smooth
Not on a sandy beach · no children (from reviews)

adviceTitle: How do you pick the right Koh Larn stay for your trip?

advice.head: Want to sleep on the beach and step straight into the sea
advice.bodyHtml: → Xanadu Beach Resort ฿1,900 on clear-water Samae Beach, with a private beach and free canvas loungers · or Tawaen Beach Resort ฿1,800 / Sukkee Beach Resort ฿1,700 on Tawaen Beach

advice.head: Want to get off the boat and straight to your room, no cross-island ride
advice.bodyHtml: → Toonja Koh Larn ฿1,100 a 3-min walk from the pier with a free golf-cart pickup · Lareena Resort ฿2,450 ~50 m from the pier · Suntosa Resort ฿2,000 a 2–3 min walk

advice.head: A couples' trip, want a pool villa with a private pool
advice.bodyHtml: → Baan Rin Rak Seaview Pool Villa from ฿4,200 (standard rooms from ฿1,600) with a private pool + Floating Breakfast, adults only

advice.head: Into photos and cafés, want a stay with character

advice.head: Laid-back type, want a live-music bar atmosphere

advice.bodyHtml: → Tawaen Beach Resort ฿1,800 on Tawaen Beach with family rooms that sleep several · or Xanadu Beach Resort ฿1,900 on Samae Beach with shallow, clear water and Family rooms (⚠️ Baan Rin Rak/Toonja are adults only)

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates from the standard room range and may change by date and season; we recommend checking the real price and comparing 3 sites before every booking. The scores and highlights in this article come from reading real guest reviews on booking platforms — we did not stay ourselves. Most stays on Koh Larn have no swimming pool because the sea serves as the natural pool, and many use filtered seawater that isn't drinkable — bring your own bottled water and personal toiletries. Baan Rin Rak and Toonja are adults only, no children. Getting there starts with the ferry from Bali Hai Pier in Pattaya (passenger ferry about 30–45 min, speedboat about 15 min). Prices rise and rooms fill up fast on long weekends and Saturday–Sunday, so book ahead and bring extra cash. Article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — common questions travellers ask about Koh Larn stays

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best place to stay on Koh Larn?
faq.a: It depends on your trip style. By review score, Toonja Koh Larn at 9.2 is the highest in the article, with the location closest to the pier. If you want to sleep on a clear-water beach, Xanadu Beach Resort is on Samae Beach. If you want a sea-view room by the pier, Lareena Resort scores 9.0. If you're a couple wanting a pool villa, Baan Rin Rak. And if you're into photography, The Castello Resort with its Tuscan castle theme.

faq.q: ❓ How much do Koh Larn stays cost?
faq.a: In this article prices start at about ฿900–4,200 per night. The most accessible are Koh Larn Sea Side Resort from ฿900, Toonja from ฿1,100, and The Castello from ฿1,200. The mid group are beachfront resorts like Sukkee, Tawaen, and Xanadu at around ฿1,700–1,900. And a highlight room like the Seaview Pool Villa at Baan Rin Rak starts at around ฿4,200. All prices are approximate starting rates from standard rooms, and they may run higher on holidays.

faq.q: ❓ Which area is best to stay in on Koh Larn?
faq.a: Na Ban pier suits people who want a quick walk off the boat, within reach of shops and the market (Toonja, Lareena, Suntosa, Baan Rin Rak, Sea Side). Tawaen Beach suits people who want to sleep on the lively main beach with a full range of water activities (Tawaen, Sukkee). Samae Beach suits people who want a quiet, clear-water beach (Xanadu). On the way to Nual Beach suits the laid-back type who can handle a raw style (PAUSE).

faq.q: ❓ Do Koh Larn stays have a swimming pool?
faq.a: Most of the stays in this article have no swimming pool, because the sea serves as the natural pool — beachfront stays like Xanadu (Samae Beach), Tawaen, and Sukkee (Tawaen Beach) let you walk straight into the sea. Baan Rin Rak has a private pool in its Seaview Pool Villa (a small private pool, not a shared one). If you really need a large shared pool, the island has higher-priced pool villas to consider.

faq.q: ❓ Which Koh Larn stay suits couples?
faq.a: The best for couples is Baan Rin Rak, an adults-only seaside boutique with a Seaview Pool Villa and Floating Breakfast. Next is Toonja Koh Larn, also adults only, quiet, with a King room with a sea view. And Lareena Resort, with a suite built out over the sea offering an almost 180-degree view and the sound of waves lulling you to sleep at night.

faq.q: ❓ How do you get to Koh Larn · how far ahead should you book?
faq.a: It starts with the ferry from Bali Hai Pier in Pattaya — the passenger ferry takes about 30–45 min (a fare in the tens of baht), or a chartered speedboat around 15 min, landing mainly at Na Ban pier. Most stays on the island are small (10–68 rooms, some just 11 rooms), so they fill up fast. For long weekends, Saturday–Sunday, and high season, book 2–4 weeks ahead or more, since prices move up quickly. Every platform offers Free Cancellation, so we recommend locking in a rate that way first, then comparing Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price, and bring extra cash since ATMs on the island are limited.
